edition: MedSync starting drafts for signed packs, v1 (29 Oct 2026)

sources.EMHS Manual 2018: Uganda Essential Medicines and Health Supplies Management Manual, Ministry of Health, November 2018 (printed page numbers)
sources.SOP 2019: Standard Operating Procedures Manual for Supply Chain Management at Health Facility Level, Ministry of Health, November 2019
sources.HMIS Manual 2010: The Health Management Information System, Volume 1: Health Unit Procedure Manual, Ministry of Health, August 2010

maxMonths.source: EMHS Manual 2018, ch. 3.3, p. 22; SOP 2019, p. 18

minMonths.source: EMHS Manual 2018, ch. 3.3, p. 22; SOP 2019, p. 18

emergencyOrderPointMonths.reason: No national emergency order point. The manuals call for an emergency order when stock falls below the 2-month minimum (EMHS Manual 2018, p. 20; HMIS Manual 2010, p. 144), which the minimum already covers.

reviewWindowMonths.source: EMHS Manual 2018, ch. 3.3, p. 21 and Table 5, p. 23 (consumption over the 2-month cycle, adjusted for days out of stock)

minHistoryDays.reason: No national figure. One full 2-month cycle, the period the national consumption formula uses.

unclassedTrimAs.reason: The manual trims N first, then E, and V last (EMHS Manual 2018, pp. 14-15) but does not say where an item with no class goes. MedSync proposes the middle: not cut first, not kept to the end.

budgetSource.reason: Only your hospital knows where its medicines budget comes from.

source.value: HMIS 105 section 6, the 41 tracer items (EMHS Manual 2018, Table 15, p. 150)

medicineIds.source: EMHS Manual 2018, Table 15, p. 150 (items S1 to S41, mapped to MedSync medicines where one exists)
unmapped: S8 Stat -pack HIV Confirmatory rapid tests, tests
S15 Ready to use Therapeutic feeds (RUTF)
notes: S3 and S29 (amoxicillin capsule and dispersible tablet) share one MedSync medicine, as do S18 and S23 (lopinavir/ritonavir tablet and pellets).
S5 is counted as the ORS sachet; the zinc tablet in the co-pack is not counted separately.
The ARV items were replaced in DHIS2 by a 50-item list in August 2024 that is not published (AHSPR 2023/24, section 2.4.1).

days.reason: No national figure for emergency carts. The manual calls stock with under 3 months left short-dated (EMHS Manual 2018, p. 64).

countWindow.daysBefore.reason: No national window. The count is entered on the month's last day (SOP 2019, p. 22); MedSync allows two days either side.

countWindow.daysAfter.reason: No national window. The count is entered on the month's last day (SOP 2019, p. 22); MedSync allows two days either side.

outOfStockShare.reason: No national threshold. When more than half the window was out of stock, the consumption figure rests on few days.

largeDifferenceUnits.reason: No national figure. A small count so differences are looked at; tune it after the first month-ends.

reportLocationKinds.source: EMHS Manual 2018, Table 5, p. 23 (closing balance = store + dispensing area count)

confirmationWindowHours.reason: No national time limit; the ward counter-signs at collection (EMHS Manual 2018, pp. 51-52). MedSync allows one day to confirm in the system.

allocationRule.source: EMHS Manual 2018, ch. 7.5, pp. 61-62 (first expiry, first out)

value.words: Accepted, the supplier was told of the difference

columns: A OPENING BALANCE at start of 2 Month Cycle
B QUANTITY RECEIVED during 2 Month Cycle
E DAYS OUT OF STOCK during 2 month Cycle
F Adjusted AMC, AMCA = (C x 30)/(60 - E)
G CLOSING BALANCE (store + dispensing area count)
I QUANTITY REQUIRED = (4 x F) - G

rule.reason: Nationally a day out of stock means none left (EMHS Manual 2018, p. 150), with no rule for part of a day. Stock cards show the balance after the day's entries.

repeatList.reason: Which medicines may be repeated is your pharmacist reviewer's and CSO's clinical choice; MedSync does not propose one.

neverRepeat.reason: Empty: your pharmacist reviewer adds any medicine that is never repeated.

maxSupplies.reason: No national figure. Up to six further supplies, then the patient is seen again.

maxPeriodDays.reason: No national figure. Six months from the prescription, then the patient is seen again.

minIntervalDays.reason: No national figure. Four weeks between supplies.

toleranceDays.reason: No national figure. A supply may be collected up to three days early.

requestWindowDays.reason: No national figure. A patient may ask up to a week before the refill is due.

lateWindowDays.reason: No national figure. A request more than two weeks after the due day is labelled late.

holdDays.reason: No national figure. A refill set aside waits one week.

holdLongerMaxDays.reason: No national figure. Never held more than two weeks from preparation.

missThreshold.reason: No national figure. Two missed collections.

value.words: The patient needs a review visit first
The medicine was changed at the last visit
The medicine is not to be continued

items.reason: MedSync's draft wording; no national list.

routingList.reason: Empty: nothing is routed to a partner until your hospital lists medicines.

neverRouted.reason: Empty: your pharmacist reviewer adds any medicine that is never routed.

responseWindowHours.reason: No national figure. A partner answers within one day.
